test_vector_casting: test the pybind11 std::vector to Python list bidirectional casting using cast_vector and load_vector
test_map_casting: test the pybind11 std::map to Python dict bidirectional casting using cast_map and load_map
test_recursive_casting: test that STL casters preserve lvalue and rvalue context for nested container values
test_optional_casting: test the pybind11 std::optional binding that converts None to nullopt and validates types
test_variant_casting: test the pybind11 std::variant binding that dispatches on int, str, float, or None input types
